In addition, the use of asynchronous socket technology improves the efficiency. The paper proposes Reachability Test Algorithm, which enables the server reliably identify which clients can not be connected by the server. So these clients should use Web Service to fetch data. Furthermore, the system uses cluster servers, hot standby scheme and load balancers to avoid single point of failure and balance the servers' load. Finally, the paper analyzes the system's reliability and efficiency, and an example is given to prove the high efficiency of the system.

articleTitle: Design of a configurable general-purpose Input/Output with event-capture
publicationTitle: 2010 Second Pacific-Asia Conference on Circuits, Communications and System
abstract: Embedded systems normally have a large number of simple peripherals or circuits. These peripherals do not need to use complex protocols to connect with CPU. Therefore, modern embedded system provides some general-purpose Input/Output ( GPIO) pins that can be configured as either inputs or outputs. For debugging the embedded systems, users could input or output some simple commands with GPIO pins and produce interrupts. However, the standard GPIO can not support to generate different interrupts with different port signals. The proposed GPIO can provide more powerful capability of signal detecting with the additional event-capture module. The GPIO module is synthesized by SMIC O.13um technology library and integrated in a SOC.

articleTitle: Design of electric power field test system based on SCM and CPLD technology
publicationTitle: 2010 Second Pacific-Asia Conference on Circuits, Communications and System
abstract: This paper introduces an on-line electric power test system in high character, strong function, and convenient operation based on single chip microprocessor (SCM) and CPLD technology. This system uses 16 bit high speed σ-Δ A/D converter, which designing a three phase voltage, current synchronization field test system. SCM selects low power MSP430F149IPAG with rich inter chip materials, which saving many more outer electric circuit and reducing system cost. This paper mainly introduces parts of system hardware and software design method in detail. Through experiment, system precision of voltage and currency is 0.1 level, which completely meet design command, and has widely application value and using prospect.

articleTitle: Research on transmission protocol based on combined symmetric key
publicationTitle: 2010 Second Pacific-Asia Conference on Circuits, Communications and System
abstract: For improving the security of data transmission in network, a secure transmission protocol based on combined symmetric key is proposed. Encryption key is one-time key while communicating, which is achieved by special key generation method and encryption hardware devices. Consequently, secret communication is guaranteed, and it meets the security requirement of network communication. Design and implementation of the above protocol are presented, and the security is analyzed.

articleTitle: The research of PLC architecture based on CAN BUS
publicationTitle: 2010 Second Pacific-Asia Conference on Circuits, Communications and System
abstract: This Paper introduces a new type of PLC architecture based on CAN BUS and embedded Arm CPU. This thesis also shows a Design Method of PLC redundance and synchronization and various working modes using CAN BUS.

articleTitle: A multiple classifier selection method with self-adaptive preferences
publicationTitle: 2010 Second Pacific-Asia Conference on Circuits, Communications and System
abstract: Clustering and Selection (CS) is a common method of multiple classifier selection. But the method judging an input sample belong to a certain area just by the shortest distance has some unilateralism. Therefore, a dual selection method based on clustering is proposed. In the method, multiple clusters are selected for a test sample and the classifier with the best weighted average performance is chosen. The chosen classifier is compared with the best classifier in the nearest cluster and the better one are used to classify the test sample. The main parameter in the method is self-adaptively selected according to the prior information of the training samples. Experiments were done on the datasets of KDD'99 and UCI to compare the proposed method with the CS method, and the experimental results show the presented method has a better classification performance.

articleTitle: The magnetic field analysis and AC loss calculation for the cable-in-conduit super-conductor coil
publicationTitle: 2010 Second Pacific-Asia Conference on Circuits, Communications and System
abstract: The magnetic field distribution of Nb<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sub>Sn super-conducting coil is analyzed and obtained when the coil flows the maximum current, the field intensity values of some particular points are given. When the pulse current flows through the super-conducting coil, the large alternate current (AC) loss will appear. Therefore, based on the calculation of the coupling loss time constant for the super-conducting coil, its AC loss are calculated accurately.

articleTitle: Prediction of track irregularities using NARX neural network
publicationTitle: 2010 Second Pacific-Asia Conference on Circuits, Communications and System
abstract: The paper proposes an approach to predict track irregularities based on accelerations of vehicle body using neural network. Firstly, a simulation vehicle model is constructed in Adams software to collect accelerations data. Secondly, two types of NARX neural networks are listed, and the series-parallel NARX neural network is selected as the inverse model to predict track irregularities. The proposed approach is applied to the estimation of the left vertical irregularity, the left lateral irregularity and level irregularity, and the results show the validity of the proposed method.

articleTitle: Coordinate transformation based Super-Exponential Iterative blind equalization algorithm
publicationTitle: 2010 Second Pacific-Asia Conference on Circuits, Communications and System
abstract: Constant Modulus Algorithm (CMA) with simple structure and robustness is not suitable for equalizing nonconstant modulus higher order QAM signals, it is necessary to turn nonconstant modulus higher order QAM signals into constant modulus fourth-order QAM in order to make CMA be used to equalize higher order QAM signals. Based on analyzing the coordinate transformation prinicple and Super-Exponential Iterative (SEI) property, a Super-Exponential Iterative blind equalization algorithm based on Coordinate Transformation (CT-SEI) is proposed. The proposed CT-SEI algorithm can obtain high convergence rate via using SEI algorithm and small steady-state error via turning nonconstant modulus higher order QAM signals into constant modulus fourth-order QAM. The performance of the proposed algorithm can be proofed by underwater acoustic channel simulation.

articleTitle: The improved EMD method based on SVD diagnose of Attractor
publicationTitle: 2010 Second Pacific-Asia Conference on Circuits, Communications and System
abstract: The Intrinsic Mode Functions (IMFS) decomposed by Empirical Mode Decomposition (EMD) often lose their physical meaning because of the unconventional data and noise. An improved EMD method based on Singular Value Decomposition (SVD) diagnosed of attractor was introduced. The SNR was improved and the decomposed component was given its meaning by this method. The original signal was diagnosed by SVD. Then useful part and redundancy were gained and the useful part was decomposed by EMD method. Thus, the interference was reduced, the decomposing ability was improved and the IMFs were more meaningful. The emulational example proved that the improved method is feasible.

articleTitle: Crawling web pages with application in online advertises monitoring system
publicationTitle: 2010 Second Pacific-Asia Conference on Circuits, Communications and System
abstract: Due to the forms and features of online advertising, an effective web crawling page method, called ‘Spider’, is designed and implemented by analyzing the information carriers and script codes of web pages. Drawing on the basis of the search engine techniques, a row of heavy method is proposed by employing the preemptive multi-threading technique. It is used to solve the excessive consumption of system resources and network bandwidth in search on the Internet with the Spider to ‘crawl’ the duplication of information downloaded.

articleTitle: Discussing about the application of data mining technology in anti-illegal immigrant intelligence
publicationTitle: 2010 Second Pacific-Asia Conference on Circuits, Communications and System
abstract: However with China entering into the WTO, the big clearance in national seaport will soon realize, immigration traveler's number will be fast increasing, at the same time, anti-illegal immigrant conflict would also be more intense and complicated. Under such condition the analysis of anti-illegal immigrant intelligence has many difficulties. So data mining technology will be introduced in anti-illegal immigrant intelligence to detect new illegal immigrant trends. This article states the process of data mining in anti-illegal immigrant consulting relevancy data mining algorithm, including data processing in advance, association rule digging out, and so forth. Mining on time sequence rule will be the important way in data mining. Through this way, the objective law of anti-illegal immigrant intelligence will be found to support decision-making.

articleTitle: Pulse design method for UWB vehicular radar system
publicationTitle: 2010 Second Pacific-Asia Conference on Circuits, Communications and System
abstract: A frequency-domain pulse design method for ultra wideband (UWB) vehicular radar system is proposed. Morlet wavelet pulses with the diverse dilatation factors are randomly selected as basis ones. By adjusting these parameters such as the dilation and the value of the amplitude spectral, the corresponding power spectral density (PSD) of linear combination pulse is obtained which must match the FCC's PSD mask as closely as possible and maximize the bandwidth. Then the combination coefficients are directly obtained by the solution of frequency-domain restraint equation group. Simulation results show that the PSD of combination pulse has larger bandwidth than that of single Morlet pulse and complies with the FCC spectrum mask.

articleTitle: The intuitionistie fuzzy sets on evaluation of risks in projects of enterprise's informationization
publicationTitle: 2010 Second Pacific-Asia Conference on Circuits, Communications and System
abstract: In economic era of information, the enterprises are facing complicated and changeable management environment, which has put forward higher requirement in adaptability to changes, innovation ability and management level to enterprises. The implementation of informatization projects is the important route, which improves the management level, strengthens the key competitiveness and realizes the management innovation. The characteristic of enterprise's informatization projects determines that there are greater risks in the implementation of the informationization. It is also the key to evalue the risk of informatization projects. This paper analysizes the risk influence factors of informatization projects,establishes risk factor index system and intuitiouistic fuzzy sets model. Finally, the model is proved feasible and effective by an example. This can provide reference value for Informatization project managers in measuring risk and preventiving measures.

articleTitle: Coplanar waveguide method for identifying the surface wave band-gap range of mushroom-like electromagnetic band-gap structure
publicationTitle: 2010 Second Pacific-Asia Conference on Circuits, Communications and System
abstract: In this paper, coplanar waveguide (CPW) method is proposed for identifying the surface wave band-gap of mushroom-like EBG structure. Two lines are cut off from the complete ground plane of the EBG structure and the defected ground plane can be viewed as a coplanar waveguide with characteristic impedance of 50 Ohm. The other layer of the EBG structure is not changed. The surface wave band-gap range can be obtained from the transmission curve of CPW in two cases: EBG inserted and no EBG inserted. Furthermore, the electric field distribution within and beyond the stop-band are studied. And we also investigate the influence of EBG rows on the band-gap. The results extracted from CPW method agrees very weD with that of TEM waveguide model. Compared to the most used experimental method, suspended microstrip line method, the CPW method is a one-layer structure which leads to be low-cost, easy-made and more effective. Both simulated and experimental results verify the effectiveness of the CPW method. Therefore, the CPW method can be applied for identifying the surface wave band-gap of EBG structure much more effectively in engineering applications.

articleTitle: Reduction techniques of the end component of PMLSM
publicationTitle: 2010 Second Pacific-Asia Conference on Circuits, Communications and System
abstract: the cause of thrust ripple of PMLSM is the detent force producing shake and noise, at the lower speed region, control performances become increasingly deteriorated. Distributing characteristic of the end component at holly journey in PMLSM was analyzed using finite element method. The effects of permanent magnet length and poles number adopting FFT cool on the end component were studied and relation curve was present comprehend in reason. Analysis results are benefit to design and operation of PMLSM.

articleTitle: Reformation of an SiGe HBT structure for reducing the effect of parasitic barriers
publicationTitle: 2010 Second Pacific-Asia Conference on Circuits, Communications and System
abstract: In this paper, an n-p-n SiGe heterojunction bipolar transistor (HBT) is investigated. The emitter and collector of this transistor are made up of silicon, and germanium dopant is linearly diffused in the base region. Adding germanium dopant causes the formation of parasitic barriers in base-emitter junction of transistor. The barrier effects are reduced by this structure. In this model, choosing the proper dopant structure, the collector current density can be increased

articleTitle: The research of indirect measurement of high-frequency clock
publicationTitle: 2010 Second Pacific-Asia Conference on Circuits, Communications and System
abstract: Two indirect methods were presented for the measurement of PLL, which were dividing frequency and bypassing reference clock, and the circuit and theory of these methods were also discussed. These methods lowered the influence of measurement circuit on the signal, and also improved the performance of measurement. They simplified the measurement of PLL, and also reduced the cost.

articleTitle: Design and implementation of real-time automatic measuring system for the vehicles' speed
publicationTitle: 2010 Second Pacific-Asia Conference on Circuits, Communications and System
abstract: In this paper, we describe the cross-correlation principle of the vehicle speed measurement, and present the hardware design of real-time embedded measuring system for the vehicles' speed. The modular programming method is used in software design to complete the computation of cross-correlation signal processing and the display of resultant data. We evaluate the performance of this system by measuring the linear speed of rotary dial on motor. It is shown by the experiments that this automatic measuring system is stable and highly reliable with low cost.

articleTitle: 3D space-time detection based control points selection of DSA
publicationTitle: 2010 Second Pacific-Asia Conference on Circuits, Communications and System
abstract: A 3D space-time motion detection based DSA control point selection algorithm is proposed. Main content is to detect the movement of image points based on the control selection and registration algorithm and using DSA image sequences to speed up the registration of control points. The image features, such as the edge, are used as the control points to register image effectively. According to the location of control points, 3D space-time characteristics are used to search control points, and it will further reduce the number of control points, and make the control point registration more accurate.

articleTitle: A method to eliminate BGP divergence based on AS relationships
publicationTitle: 2010 Second Pacific-Asia Conference on Circuits, Communications and System
abstract: The Border Gateway Protocol, BGP, is currently the de-facto inter-domain routing protocol employed on the Internet. It is responsible for exchanging routing information between autonomous systems(ASes) and selecting routes to destination networks. Each AS defines and applies local policies to select routes and propagate routes to neighboring ASes. However, studies show that conflicting local policies among a collection of ASes can lead to BGP divergence. This paper presents an online method to eliminate BGP divergence. The proposed method uses the AS path history, which is composed of the AS path contained in the best route, to discover routes divergence. When there is a cycle of AS path in the history, the potential BGP divergence occurs. In order to eliminate the BGP divergence, the proposed method adjusts the routes preference of involving based on AS relationships and advertise best routes according to relationship between announcer AS and receiver AS.

articleTitle: MOSFET simulation using neuro-fuzzy network
publicationTitle: 2010 Second Pacific-Asia Conference on Circuits, Communications and System
abstract: In this paper, we apply a neuro-fuzzy network for simulating MOSFETs. The training data was obtained by various simulations in PSPICE. Comparison between PSPICE simulation and the implemented method indicated that the neuro-fuzzy network is a suitable model to be incorporated in spice-like simulators for MOSFET simulations and it would be a good replacement for sub-circuits which their simulations using complicated mathematical models are too time consuming.

articleTitle: The research of synchronization control with PLC based on the bus of serial communications
publicationTitle: 2010 Second Pacific-Asia Conference on Circuits, Communications and System
abstract: This Paper analyzes the structure of serial industrial fieldbus such as RS485, CAN and agreement stipulations of MODBUS and CAN2.0. It expounds the new PLC synchronous control method based on a serial bus between each module, control strategy of the synchronizing time examination mechanism, pre-synchronizing information processing and `free synchronization' and `forced synchronization' .

articleTitle: The application and implementation of SIP in Next Generation Network (NGN)
publicationTitle: 2010 Second Pacific-Asia Conference on Circuits, Communications and System
abstract: With the comprehensive development of Next Generation Network (NGN), voice calls on IPv6 (VoIP over IPv6)is the general trend. This paper studies the core Signaling Control Protocol of NGN-SIP features and structure, analyzes the model based on SIP, researches the framework of voice within SIP, eventually proposed the way to complete the voice calls in the environment of IPv6.

articleTitle: Multiuser detection based on the EM iterative algorithm in non-Gaussian noise
publicationTitle: 2010 Second Pacific-Asia Conference on Circuits, Communications and System
abstract: Because of the different interference in existence, signal will be inevitably eroded while transmitting. The EM iterative algorithm is commonly used in recent years for missing data, which has the character of easy and popular applicability. So based on the EM iterative algorithm multi-user detection is proposed. In non-Gaussian noise simulation numerical is carried out, the results show that the proposed algorithm has bad performance in non-Gaussian noise, but convergence of variations less with robustness.

articleTitle: The performance evaluation and empirical analysis of China Social Security Fund portfolio
publicationTitle: 2010 Second Pacific-Asia Conference on Circuits, Communications and System
abstract: For examining whether the China Social Security Fund has made beyond the basic market and created value for the investors, this paper selects the seven combinations with holding a larger absolute number to 17 types of social security fund portfolio, and explains the whole performances, such as Shape's measure, Treynor's measure and Jensen's measure in 2009 year. Besides, the capabilities of the fund's stock selection and market-timing are also been studied for seven main funds. It is concluded that the social security fund portfolio is better than the basic market. Although some combination of stock selection ability is outstanding performance, all the funds did not show strong timing ability.

articleTitle: Decomposition and composition mechanism applied in control system modeling language
publicationTitle: 2010 Second Pacific-Asia Conference on Circuits, Communications and System
abstract: Models can liberate engineers from system complexity, which brings an efficient way for developing large-scale, complex and reliable real-time system. A key technology is decomposition and composition of models. Complicated problems can be decomposed into simple issues through decomposition of models. Composition of models must deal with complex relationships between every parts of the system, so that they can be composed in whole. This paper shows the decomposition and composition mechanism applied in CSML meta-model.

articleTitle: Design of high precision CMOS voltage reference
publicationTitle: 2010 Second Pacific-Asia Conference on Circuits, Communications and System
abstract: a stable bandgap CMOS voltage reference is designed for LED driver by combining with self-starting circuit and multi-valued bias voltage generating circuit modules. The circuits are designed by using CSMC 0.5µm CMOS process. Simulation results by Cadence software show that the temperature coefficient is about 10ppm/°C, zero temperature coefficient is about at 31°C, close to room temperature. And good temperature characteristics can be achieved in practical applications. Meanwhile, power supply rejection ratio is up to 80dB, which can meet the requirement of LED driver IC.

articleTitle: Design and research of high precision information flow measurement system
publicationTitle: 2010 Second Pacific-Asia Conference on Circuits, Communications and System
abstract: This paper introduces a kind of research and design method of high precision information flow measurement system. System is mainly composed of microprocessor, HART communication module, RS485 communication module, temperature and press. Etc analogy input module, as well as display and print drive module, and so on. System software function mainly has real time iterative solution algorithm of calculating flow and serial communication protocol, etc. This paper mainly introduces part of research and design content of system in detail.

articleTitle: An ant optimization method for path planning on a cuboid
publicationTitle: 2010 Second Pacific-Asia Conference on Circuits, Communications and System
abstract: Path planning on the surfaces of a cuboid is widespread in engineering applications. It has been employed in many areas, such as network routing, the emergency rescuing upon high-rise buildings, wall-climbing robots picking and placing on a box-shaped objects, a large scale cleaning on roofs or walls, as well as painting for furniture. There are three types, including 21 cases, of the distances between city pairs on the surface of a cuboid. Thus, the calculating the minimum distance methods are introduced in this paper by expanding and flipping the alternative faces of the cuboid. And then a new ant colony optimization-based method to solve the travelling salesman problems on the surfaces of a cuboid is presented and is tested on several TSPLIB benchmarks and some random point sets. Experimental results show that the proposed method is feasible and effective.

articleTitle: An approach to determine inverse relations of basic cardinal direction relations
publicationTitle: 2010 Second Pacific-Asia Conference on Circuits, Communications and System
abstract: The spatial relation reasoning is an important branch of spatial knowledge processing. The inverse relation of cardinal direction relation is an important tool for spatial direction reasoning. However, present determine all the inverse relations of the cardinal direction relation. Based on the minimum bounding rectangle (short for MBR), a quadruple model of cardinal direction relation is proposed. Then we analyze the constraints between cardinal direction relations and their inverse relations which are represented by the quadruple model. Finally, a novel method is put forward for determining the inverse relation of any cardinal direction relation

articleTitle: The research of wireless sensor network routing algorithm for underground
publicationTitle: 2010 Second Pacific-Asia Conference on Circuits, Communications and System
abstract: Based on the harsh underground environment and complex monitoring data, some sensors that have different purposes need to be set up, a routing algorithm(LEACH-N)suitable for underground heterogeneous wireless sensor networks is proposed . In the algorithm, according to energy distribution network in the different nodes, the weight factor is introduced for cluster head's selection as the regulation parameter. During the electoral process each node's energy consumption, distance with the base station and the number of elected cluster heads should be synthetically taken into account. In the stable data transmission phase, the cluster heads adopt multi-hop transmission way to transfer data to sink node through the integration of data processing. Finally, MATLAB is used for the simulation and theoretical research to the new algorithm. The result of the simulation shows that the algorithm can reduce the energy consumption of cluster heads, balance the network load, thereby prolonging the network lifetime.

articleTitle: Modeling and simulation of logic circuits using CNFETs and interconnects
publicationTitle: 2010 Second Pacific-Asia Conference on Circuits, Communications and System
abstract: In this paper a new RLC model of a CNFET is presented. The S parameter formulation and analysis is utilized to investigate this two port model for drain to source signal transmission. The characteristic of the new topology is that using CNT interconnects instead of metallic ones, makes the model comfortable to be used in structures with more than one transistor connected to each other like VLSI circuits. Some logic circuits are simulated due to this approach in the end. All simulations are done in software “ADS 2008”.

articleTitle: Intelligent bees for QoS routing in Networks-on-Chip
publicationTitle: 2010 Second Pacific-Asia Conference on Circuits, Communications and System
abstract: Networks-on-Chip (NoCs) for future many-core processor platforms integrate more and more heterogeneous components of different types and many real-time and latency-sensitive applications can run on a single chip concurrently. The reconfigurable FPGA and reconfigurable NoCs have emerged for the purpose of reusability. Those types' traffics within NoCs exhibit diverse, burst, and unpredictable communication patterns. QoS guaranteed mechanisms are necessary to provide guaranteed throughput (GT) or guaranteed bandwidth (GB) performance for NoCs. In this paper, we propose a QoS routing algorithm inspired by bees' foraging behaviors to provide guaranteed bandwidth performance. Virtual circuits and Spatial Division Multiplexing are employed to maintain available paths for different type's traffics.

articleTitle: Campus Scientific Research management system security and solutions
publicationTitle: 2010 Second Pacific-Asia Conference on Circuits, Communications and System
abstract: Because Scientific Research level has been an important indicator of college power, it's necessary to set up an Scientific research management system and make daily Scientific Management more normatively and effectively. In the process of exploiting and using Scientific research management system, security has always been given the first priority since it is pivotal for the survival of the system. This paper describes the status of campus Scientific research management system, analyses the current major problems and hidden dangers, proposed a viewpoint to solve the security issues, including authentication, access control, communications security and digital signatures, expected to provide some help with the management of Campus Scientific Research.

articleTitle: Designand realization of a high-precision numericalcontrol current souse
publicationTitle: 2010 Second Pacific-Asia Conference on Circuits, Communications and System
abstract: It is the design and application of digital controlled DC current source with an output range between 20mA to 2000mA, which was realized by making use of the single-chip microcomputer system, D/A and A/D converter, constant current source electric circuit, etc. In paper the frame drawing and main circuit were introduced. This design applied degenerative feedback closed loop control system, in order to advanced the output precision. Testing results show that this DC current source have credibility performance and high precision.

publicationTitle: 2010 Second Pacific-Asia Conference on Circuits, Communications and System
abstract: Retracted.
