publicationTitle: 2010 Second Pacific-Asia Conference on Circuits, Communications and System
abstract: Retracted.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: Researching the MLDT of the materiel system with particular mission
publicationTitle: 2010 Second Pacific-Asia Conference on Circuits, Communications and System
abstract: This article has been retracted by the publisher.

articleTitle: Scheduling algorithms in Wireless Mesh Networks: A review
publicationTitle: 2010 Second Pacific-Asia Conference on Circuits, Communications and System
abstract: Wireless Mesh Network (WMN) is considered to be an effective solution to support multimedia services in last miles due to their automatic configuration and low cost deployment. The main feature of WMNs is multi-hope communications which may result in increased region coverage, better robustness and more capacity. Implemented on limited radio range wireless media, WMNs bring about many challenges such as fading alleviation, effective media access control, efficient routing, quality of service provisioning, call admission control and scheduling. In this paper main concepts of scheduling in mesh networks are introduced and its basic techniques in WMNs are reviewed.

articleTitle: Hybrid programming for simulation of axial symmetry ablation
publicationTitle: 2010 Second Pacific-Asia Conference on Circuits, Communications and System
abstract: Based on multi-computer languages, the system frame and the main program of ablation software in axial symmetry ablation are designed. The ablation of axial symmetry ablation is generally caused by a high temperature, a high pressure and oxidation airflow. The ablation rate and heat flow field in axial symmetry may be directly simulated by using FORTRAN program on the base of the chemistry ablation model under extreme environments. Combining with characters of both MATLAB and VC++, the pre- and post-treatment of the software are finished by a hybrid programming method, and its portability is realized by Setup Factory software. It can be seen from simulation that the software may run without building environment under WINDOWS and the input of initial parameters and the graphic display of the numerical solution are easy to finish.

articleTitle: Operating condition recognition in ball mill based on discriminant PLS
publicationTitle: 2010 Second Pacific-Asia Conference on Circuits, Communications and System
abstract: Operating condition recognition of a ball mill is an important part in grinding process. The load status can only be determined according to expert's experiences. If common operating conditions (such as under-load, best-load, and over-load) are not monitored and handled promptly and accurately, the quality of the grinding product may deteriorate or even the grinding production may come to a stop. This paper estimates the power spectral density of the input vibration and acoustic signals using Welch's averaged modified periodogram method of spectral estimation. Unsupervised Fuzzy C-Means classification and Partial Least Squares for Discrimination (DPLS) are used to build operating status model for the ball mill. Experimental results shown recognition capability is enhanced, the false alarming rate is decreased.

Author Keywords: operating condition of the ball mill

articleTitle: Adaptive H.264 video coding for low-complexity decoding in packet-loss environment
publicationTitle: 2010 Second Pacific-Asia Conference on Circuits, Communications and System
abstract: The state-of-the-art H.264 video coding standard enables significant improvement of compression performance compared with previous standards; however, the computational complexity at both encoder and decoder are inevitably increased. In this paper, we propose an adaptive H.264 video encoding scheme to reduce the decoding complexity based on an end-to-end distortion model, especially considering its transmission over wireless networks. In order to yield the good rate-distortion performance under power constraint in packet loss environment, we generate the lightweight bit-stream at encoder side, which can be decoded with less interpolation operations. Moreover, channel distortion caused by the instability of network is considered in the proposed model. The experiment results show that the proposed method performs well in both error free and packet loss environments, while the complexity in video decoding is significantly reduced.

articleTitle: Comparison of MAC protocols between WiMAX and LTE
publicationTitle: 2010 Second Pacific-Asia Conference on Circuits, Communications and System
abstract: WiMAX based on series of IEEE 802.16 standards and 3GPP LTE are the two important development directions of next generation broadband wireless communication. In physical layers, in order to transmit high speed data flow in limited bandwidth, they both use the OFDM technology and MIMO technology to enhance system capacity and frequency spectral efficiency, avoid inter symbol interference, and improve system performance. But, they have more different methods in design of MAC protocols and sublayer allocation of MAC functions. In this paper, we firstly introduce the MAC protocols in WiMAX 16e and 3GPP LTE Release 8. Then compare their MAC functions in control plane and data plane, and provide the comparison chart of MAC functions between WiMAX and LTE. It shows that they both provide the MAC basic functions though they have various differences in realization mechanism and function division.

articleTitle: Fault diagnosis of air-conditioning fan based on RBF neural networks algorithm
publicationTitle: 2010 Second Pacific-Asia Conference on Circuits, Communications and System
abstract: In order to overcome the problems of slow rate of convergence, falling easily into local minimum and instability of learning performance caused by initial value in BP algorithm, the diagnosis method based on RBF neural networks was proposed. And the diagnosis method is applied to air-conditioning fan fault diagnosis. The result shows that RBF network has very high learning convergence speed and better classifying performance. RBF network has good practicality in the field of equipment fault diagnosis.

articleTitle: Implementation of simple video clip device based on Directshow
publicationTitle: 2010 Second Pacific-Asia Conference on Circuits, Communications and System
abstract: MPEG-2 standard become a very important image compression standard, but the Nonlinear Edition of MPEG-2 IPB Standard Code For Streaming Format become a worldwide problem. A simple video clip device is proposed in this paper which is designed especially to MPEG-2 IPB Standard Code. It is implemented by DES which is a series of DirectShow-based video editing programming interfaces. VC6. 0 was used to realize the software which is reusable and expandable.

articleTitle: Analysis and anti-jamming performance of partial band for IDMA systems
publicationTitle: 2010 Second Pacific-Asia Conference on Circuits, Communications and System
abstract: IDMA can be regarded as a special case of CDMA, where the spreading can be done by an arbitrary low rate channel code equal for all users and the separation can be done by user-specific interleavers. In this paper, we provide the anti-jamming performance analysis of partial band for IDMA systems. First, we investigate the basic principle of IDMA briefly. Then introduce the generation of the partial band jamming model and the cancellation of the partial band jamming in IDMA systems. The theoretical analysis and simulation results show that the iteration, spreading gain, the number of users, and the power of jamming will affect the performance of IDMA systems. Especially, the power of partial band jamming is the maximum impact factors for IDMA systems in the circumstances of partial band jamming.

articleTitle: Fuzzy control based energy management strategy for combined power system
publicationTitle: 2010 Second Pacific-Asia Conference on Circuits, Communications and System
abstract: A combined power system for the hybrid electric vehicle (HEV), which composed with storage batteries and ultra-capacitors, was studied in this paper. Firstly, the simulation model of the designed system was built. For both the charging and discharging, the energy management strategy based on fuzzy logic was designed,respectively. Then the simulation model of the HEV with the combined power system was founded based on the Advisor software. The simulation results indicates that the proposed energy management strategy can effectively split the powers between the storage batteries and the ultra-capacitors in the combined power system,. And a better acceleration performance and economic performance can be obtained. Also the life time of the batteries can be added.

articleTitle: Study on multi-Agent model of weapon equipment systems
publicationTitle: 2010 Second Pacific-Asia Conference on Circuits, Communications and System
abstract: This paper expatiate Swarm which can solve the problem of complex adaptive systems, Weapon equipment systems can be disposed by CAS theory, Because it can use this method to deal with the problem. After that, it designs a multi-Agent/CA model frame of weapon equipment systems, then discuss the critical technology of the model, At last it illuminates the next step of the emulation.

articleTitle: Analysis of practical control tactics on built environment intelligent control system
publicationTitle: 2010 Second Pacific-Asia Conference on Circuits, Communications and System
abstract: In this paper, Based on the research platform of built environment intelligent control system of VAV(variable air volume) air-conditioning system and the corresponding intelligent control system, through the systematic introduction and description, Investigate the control tactics of VAV system, it can be obtained the new control scheme debug and run mode of that VAV systems applying, analysis of system operating parameters, debugging methods and empirical data about the typical condition of operation data analysis of VAV system, proposed project on the practical new control tactics. It will provide the basis for our intelligent building design, construction operation and energy conservation.

articleTitle: Research on UPQC energy optimization method under three-phase balance
publicationTitle: 2010 Second Pacific-Asia Conference on Circuits, Communications and System
abstract: As a new device for power quality improvement, UPQC can deal with voltage and current quality problems. In order to minimize unit volume and lower the cost, this paper has researched on a typical voltage drop with phase jump and three-phase rectifier load conditions to optimize the energy. By adjusting voltage phase and controlling amplitude and phase of the target current function, the average active power of load will be provided entirely by the power grid, and also the active power exchange between UPQC and grid will be minimized. At the same time, in order to prevent the voltage waveform interruption of the load, a gradient control method is used. Simulation results confirm the validity and feasibility of the method.

articleTitle: Study on comparison between JAFMAS and JADE
publicationTitle: 2010 Second Pacific-Asia Conference on Circuits, Communications and System
abstract: With the gradual deepening of the Agent system research and the appearance of more application systems based on multi-agent technology, the development technology of Agent and multi-agent system has become an important research topic and they are widely applied in many fields such as electronic commerce, search and rescue on sea, information management and so on. On the basis of brief introduction of the multi-agent system development frameworks JAFMAS and JADE, their architecture and interaction mechanism are compared in this paper. Moreover, the relationship and differences between JAFMAS and JADE are illustrated with the implementation of Agent application in these two frameworks. Based on the comparison above, the advantages and shortages of JAFMAS and JADE are concluded in the end of this paper.

articleTitle: A study of the automated logistics system of YOUNGOR's distribution center
publicationTitle: 2010 Second Pacific-Asia Conference on Circuits, Communications and System
abstract: This paper involves a study of the automated logistics system of YOUNGOR's distribution center, which includes an integrated computer management and control system, a set of ASRS (Automated Storage and Retrieval System), a multi-story warehouse system, a sorting and conveying system, and other related auxiliary equipments. A central information system was dedicatedly designed for the logistics system of apparel industry, which was integrated with WMS, ERP and DRP system. The results of this pilot project show the good potential for promoting the use of ASRS within apparel industry in China. The study and practice will help apparel companies to assess the benefits of automated logistics system in their day to day operations.

articleTitle: A circuit design of natural logarithmic resistance/period conversion in semiconductor resistance sensors
publicationTitle: 2010 Second Pacific-Asia Conference on Circuits, Communications and System
abstract: According to the fact that the exponential relationship exists between the semiconductor resistance and the measured quantity in most semiconductor resistance sensors, a circuit design of natural logarithmic resistance/period conversion is proposed in the paper, the circuit is analyzed in detail, and the period formula of this conversion circuit is derived. This circuit design scheme can expand applicable range of semiconductor resistance sensors and improve measurement accuracy, which has good practicability. Finally a simple and practical natural logarithmic resistance/period conversion circuit with single power supply is given in the paper.

articleTitle: Performance evaluation of an improved distributed power-control scheme for cellular mobile systems
publicationTitle: 2010 Second Pacific-Asia Conference on Circuits, Communications and System
abstract: The distributive power-control (DPC) schemes have been developed to cope with computational complexities arising from CPC schemes. In this paper, a new DPC scheme is suggested to improve the convergence speed and system robustness against carrier-to-interference-ratio (CIR) estimation errors. To expedite the CIR balancing in our DPC scheme, an instability detection rule is used. Numerical results indicate that the proposed algorithm, as compared with Foschini's DPC (FDPC) and three other newer methods, achieves performance improvements in terms of outage probability as well as algorithm's convergence speed. More specifically, by appropriate selection of some parameters, the algorithm speed increases from about 90 iterations in FDPC to 9 iterations in the proposed algorithm. We use a detection rule to expedite the cell-removal process. The system robustness against CIR estimation errors is also explored.

articleTitle: Research on the maintenance staff number forecast method of the military technical officer in equipment maintain department
publicationTitle: 2010 Second Pacific-Asia Conference on Circuits, Communications and System
abstract: Change of the number of the military technical officer maintenance staff of different levels in equipment maintain department has the characteristics of radomicity and non-aftereffect property, uses Markov chain to forecast and adjust the number of the maintenance staff. Based on the rationale of Markov chain, constructs the number forecast model of the maintenance staff, confirms the transition matrix of probability, and forecasts the maintenance staff number of different levels of an equipment maintain department from 2010 to 2012.

Author Keywords: forecast of the maintenance staff number

articleTitle: Clustering processing ant colony algorithm
publicationTitle: 2010 Second Pacific-Asia Conference on Circuits, Communications and System
abstract: Contrary to TSP with clustering features, clustering processing ant colony algorithm (CPACA) is studied in this paper. CPACA first clusters cities in TSP, the TSP problem is decomposed into many small-scale sub-problems (the number of sub-problems equals to the clustering number of cities), then each sub-problem is solved using the ant colony algorithm in parallel, and solutions for all sub-problems are to be merged into the solution to solve the problem according to certain rules. As the problem is decomposed using the clustering characteristics of the problem itself, to solve each sub-problem in parallel, then to speed up the solving speed greatly.

articleTitle: A Optimum Coding (OC)schema for information management system
publicationTitle: 2010 Second Pacific-Asia Conference on Circuits, Communications and System
abstract: It is necessary for many different information processing systems to make coding based on the information entities by using classification or level. The design and structure of coding have a high effect on the data access and operating in a system. This paper mainly describes the effectiveness of coding according to good recollection and operations, and proposes a Optimum Coding(OC) schema, or Non Prefix Coding(NPC). It is demonstrated much superiority in computer information processing based on classification. It has a feather of unfixed length, and its mean length of input coding required is constant O(1) in retrieving and editing, which is superior to general Field Sequence Code (FSC) that is O(n) compared with that of OC.

articleTitle: Service chain optimization (SCO) scheme based on business performance
publicationTitle: 2010 Second Pacific-Asia Conference on Circuits, Communications and System
abstract: This paper presents a methodology for composing a SOA service chain by evaluating and selecting a service for the purpose of business result optimization. The methodology requires the business performance model for applied services to measure the value produced by services in a specific business context. Understanding the business characteristics where services are applied is a prerequisite for evaluating the business value of a business process that uses these services. The quality characteristics of SOA services could lead to the varieties of business optimization result, or to select simply optimal path of service chain. In this paper, we analyze the business performance and quality characteristics of SOA services and present a service composition scheme for optimizing business result.

articleTitle: Implementation of an instruction dispatch unit applied to digital signal processors with VLIW architecture
publicationTitle: 2010 Second Pacific-Asia Conference on Circuits, Communications and System
abstract: Digital signal processor (DSP) is a particular kind of processor that is able to achieve a variety of digital signal processing algorithms rapidly. Nowadays, the hardware of the DSP of the high performance relies on the Very Long Instruction Words (VLIW) architecture, which takes advantage of instruction level parallelism and executes instructions in parallel to accomplish computing-intensive tasks. However, VLIW machines are strict not only in instruction dispatching but also with the control of the branch. It is essential to ensure the correct executions of the programs in every pipeline stage. In this paper, an instruction dispatch unit is proposed, which serves to VLIW processors. It is modeled and detailed described in Verilog HDL, emulated by VCS tools and synthesized by Design Compiler in 0.13 μm CMOS technology. The final result indicates that the dispatch unit works well at the clock rate of 400 MHz, as the critical path delay of the proposed design is 2.3 ns.

articleTitle: 802.1x relay: A new model for authentication of nat-enabled router
publicationTitle: 2010 Second Pacific-Asia Conference on Circuits, Communications and System
abstract: A broadband router with the Network Address Translation (NAT) technology is popular in the private networks. The compatibility with various access authentication mechanisms of public network is a key issue for achieving interconnects between public network and private network. This paper presents a compatible method for the broadband router to support various 802.1x authentication mechanisms. Adopting this method, the broadband router can be authenticated and authorized without a complex program in various authentication scenarios.

articleTitle: UC-EBG on reflector for 3.4S-GHz frequency band antenna array application
publicationTitle: 2010 Second Pacific-Asia Conference on Circuits, Communications and System
abstract: A compact MIMO antenna using a UC-EBG structure as reflector applied in IMT -advanced is proposed. It consists of 3 × 2 CPW-fed CPS dipoles. We conducted the antenna array in terms of active impedance, and test many parameters of the antenna. Unlike the conventional reflector, the distance between the radiating patch and reflector is 1 cm, which is much shorter than λ / 4. It can decrease the bulk of the antenna array, and the mutual coupling between adjacent elements also decreased. In addition, the gain and directivity of the antenna array was increased.

articleTitle: The analysis of China electric power marketing and strategies
publicationTitle: 2010 Second Pacific-Asia Conference on Circuits, Communications and System
abstract: The power industry is related to the national economy and basic industries. In recent years, the development of market economy in China accelerated their pace of change in the electricity market to supply the company with unprecedented challenges, the power company to carry out marketing a top priority of business. Marketing will have a direct impact on the power business in a competitive market that can survive and develop. This article, from the current of the power industry, analyses the marketing of our electricity problems, and make the power of marketing strategy.

articleTitle: XML document compression based on BWT algorithm
publicationTitle: 2010 Second Pacific-Asia Conference on Circuits, Communications and System
abstract: XML documents are widely used in the data exchange of applications, its large amount of redundant information seriously cost the transmitting and storing resource because of adding tags to every semantic content unit. XML data compression is an effective means to reduce its space expansion. This paper implements a compression algorithm of XML documents. Firstly, structure information and data information of XML document are isolated and then data dictionary is established to replace and simplify the XML document. Secondly, the BWT algorithm and run-length coding are used to compress the XML document. Lastly, the final compressed file is obtained by using the Gzip tool. The algorithm has a better compression ratio with relatively less time and space resources.

articleTitle: Electronic innovation design manufacturing practice based on CAD
publicationTitle: 2010 Second Pacific-Asia Conference on Circuits, Communications and System
abstract: This paper introduces function of Altium Designer in electronic innovation design manufacturing practice, and completes design practice through some circuit design and simulation. In designing circuit system, Altium Designer can realize circuit simulation such as operating point analysis, transient/Fourier analysis. AC small signal analysis, etc. Simulation before circuit designing, we can carry out circuit componen't footprint selection, and can reduce design time and cost, etc, which will improve design efficiency.

articleTitle: Agent-based semantic web service composition model
publicationTitle: 2010 Second Pacific-Asia Conference on Circuits, Communications and System
abstract: When a single Web information service can not match the needs of users, it is necessary to combine multiple Web services to meet the application. There are many methods about service composition in semantic Web, but the satisfying quality about matching speed and load balance has not been resolved. In this paper, the idea of decomposition about Web application was presented and a structure model of Agent was built according to the characteristics of Agent in Web. Focused on solving the matching speed and load balance, an Agent-based information service composition model was proposed, and an improved matching algorithm driven by Agent was also introduced in the strategy of the model.

articleTitle: Intuitionistic fuzzy residuated logic and Galois connection
publicationTitle: 2010 Second Pacific-Asia Conference on Circuits, Communications and System
abstract: This paper aims at developing the logic theories of intuitionistic fuzzy sets. Starting from the intuitionistic fuzzy set and a defined lattice L*, a residuated lattice induced by L* is proposed which shows the structure of truth values of IF logic based on the IF algebra. Some basic properties of logic operation are presented. In the last, we define four pairs of logic operators based on the intuitionistic fuzzy residuated logic and obtain four pairs of Galois connections.

articleTitle: P-type complementary pass-transistor adiabatic logic circuits for active leakage reduction
publicationTitle: 2010 Second Pacific-Asia Conference on Circuits, Communications and System
abstract: With rapid technology scaling, gate leakage has become a significant component in currently used nanometer CMOS processes without high-k metal gate structure. This paper presents a P-type implementation scheme for complementary pass-transistor adiabatic logic circuit (P-type CP AL) to reduce the gate-leakage power dissipations, which consist mostly of PMOS transistors. A full adder is verified using the P-type CP AL scheme. All circuits are verified with HSPICE using the 65nm CMOS process with gate oxide materials. BSIM4 model is adopted to reflect the characteristics of the leakage currents. Based on the power dissipation models of CP AL adiabatic circuits, active leakage dissipations are estimated by testing total leakage dissipations using SPICE simulations. Compared with traditional N-type CP AL counterparts, the proposed P-type CP AL circuits consume low static power, because PMOS transistors have an order of magnitude smaller gate leakage than NMOS ones.

articleTitle: Performance analysis of random access system with monitoring function
publicationTitle: 2010 Second Pacific-Asia Conference on Circuits, Communications and System
abstract: In the Internet of Things, the remote monitoring, network status tracking, fault alarm, automatic measurement and control functions of the random access system require the system has the function of the receiver to send client feedback monitoring information. For the network status monitoring requirements in the Internet of Things, this article proposes a monitoring function for random access system, and we get to the throughput, idle rate and information packet collision rate of the system with the average cycle analysis method, through computer simulations to verify the correctness of the analysis.

articleTitle: Optimizing Q factor of square spiral antenna
publicationTitle: 2010 Second Pacific-Asia Conference on Circuits, Communications and System
abstract: The main purpose of this paper is to design a 1-arm square spiral antenna with Q factor as low as possible to achieve higher bandwidths. The spiral made from material of 2.8 × 10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">7</sup> Siemens/meter conductivity is printed over a dielectric material Rogers RT Duroid 5870 with permittivity 2.33, size 125 × 115 mm and thickness 0.5 mm. The operating center frequency of antenna is set to 2.45 GHz. HFSS (High Frequency Structural Simulator) is used for designing, analyzing and comparing different spiral antenna designs. Simulated results obtained from HFSS are compared at the end showing the desired results being achieved. The Q factor is lowered down to as low as 0.02 (absolute value) to achieve wide bandwidth.

Author Keywords: Lowering Q factor in square spiral antennas

articleTitle: Monitor system of Power Network parameters basing on optical fiber sensor
publicationTitle: 2010 Second Pacific-Asia Conference on Circuits, Communications and System
abstract: Remotely monitored by optical-fiber sensor array, the parameters of Power Network is processed by computer, then the data is transferred in optical communication technique, the supervisors carry out the remote monitoring by connecting the internet, In sensing, communication, monitoring for the trunk, basing on practical application, we can establish practical and feasible remote monitor system of power network parameters, so the program is made for the construction of electric power firm.

articleTitle: Research on a novel combind optimization method based on MA and PS
publicationTitle: 2010 Second Pacific-Asia Conference on Circuits, Communications and System
abstract: A novel multi-agent particle swarm optimization algorithm (MAPS) is proposed for optimal reactive power dispatch and voltage control of power system. The method integrates multi-agent system and particle swarm optimization algorithm. An agent in MAPS represents a particle to particle swarm optimization and a candidate solution to the optimization problem. All agents live in a lattice-like environment, with each agent fixed on a lattice-point. In order to decrease fitness value, quickly, agents compete and cooperate with their neighbors. and they can also use knowledge. Making use of these agent interactions and evolution mechanism of particle swarm optimization. MAPS realizes the purpose or minimizing the value or objective function. MAPS applied for optimal reactive power is evaluated on an IEEE 30-bus power system. It is shown that the proposed approach converges to better solutions much faster than the earlier reported approaches.

articleTitle: A swarm-intelligence based solution for evolutionary game
publicationTitle: 2010 Second Pacific-Asia Conference on Circuits, Communications and System
abstract: To address the problem of quick searching for evolutionary stable strategy in replicated dynamic mechanism, a solving algorithm based on parallel particle sub-swarm optimization (PSSO) is proposed. Firstly, evaluating function is introduced to integrate multiple objectives of all strategies. Secondly, multiplier method is used to derivate the fitness function. Finally, the optimal solution of strategy selection scheme is generated. The results show that the proposed algorithm performs better than standard particle swarm optimization in terms of optimal solution.

articleTitle: Research on intrusion detection approach based on signature generation
publicationTitle: 2010 Second Pacific-Asia Conference on Circuits, Communications and System
abstract: According to the current network state, the concept and key technology of intrusion detection were analyzed in this paper and then an intrusion detection approach based on signature generation was proposed. To evaluate the effectiveness of the detection method proposed in this paper, the CAIDA data sets on witty worm were used.

articleTitle: Research on routing technology in broadband over power line
publicationTitle: 2010 Second Pacific-Asia Conference on Circuits, Communications and System
abstract: As the rapid development on power line communication, broadband over power line (BPL) communication become a new research hotspot in the field of communications. But as the loads in electric distribution network change frequently, it makes the communication channel and logical topology of BPL networks change as well. Therefore, the ordinary routing algorithms in computer networks cannot meet requirements to transmit packets in the broadband power-line network. In this paper, first, the physical topology and network logical topology of MV/LV electric distribution networks is given. Finally, the current research of routing protocols in BPL networks is summarized.

articleTitle: Efficient hash chain traversal based on binary tree inorder traversal
publicationTitle: 2010 Second Pacific-Asia Conference on Circuits, Communications and System
abstract: This paper presents an algorithm to improve the time and space complexity of reverse hash chain traversal. Mapping the traversing of a reverse hash chain to the inorder traversing of a binary tree, the proposed algorithm chooses auxiliary nodes saved by stack dynamically with the help of the binomial tree model, and achieves low time and space complexity for the traversing of a reverse hash chain with any length. Analyzing the time and space complexity with the help of the binomial tree model, the result shows that the proposed algorithm requires only ⌈ log<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf>n ⌉ / 2 hash operations per chain link traversal and ⌈ log<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf>n ⌉ + 1 chain links to be save at the same time, where n is the length of the reverse hash chain. Compared to other algorithms, our algorithm can be applied to hash chain with any length without the limitation that the length must be of 2 integer-th power, and the proof is more exact.

articleTitle: Study on the wavelet threshold image de-noising method
publicationTitle: 2010 Second Pacific-Asia Conference on Circuits, Communications and System
abstract: This paper introduces the principle of wavelet multi-resolution analysis. The wavelet threshold de-noising method is described. Some key problems on the wavelet threshold de-noising method are discussed in detail. The experimental results show that the wavelet threshold de-noising method can better preserve image details and its de-noising effect is better than that of the traditional filtering method.

articleTitle: Analysis of power industry's technological progress contribution based on Solow's residual method
publicationTitle: 2010 Second Pacific-Asia Conference on Circuits, Communications and System
abstract: Nowadays, technological progress plays a more and more important role in the development of electric power industry. This paper collects data about the development of electric power industry in the past decade, and calculates the contribution degree of technology by using Solow method of remainder. Based on the analysis, the conclusion is drawn that at present China's power industry should seize the opportunities brought by the world new energy development and the intelligent electrical network construction, and realize electric economy's high-quality development relying on technological progress.

articleTitle: The measurement of power plant desulphurization system to improve atmospheric quality effect
publicationTitle: 2010 Second Pacific-Asia Conference on Circuits, Communications and System
abstract: It has great significance that measure and evaluate improvement effect of coal-fired power plant desulphurization systems to atmospheric quality improvement. The currently evaluation method of coal-fired power plants desulphurization systems to environmental impact have mainly fuzzy pattern recognition, grey correlation analysis, analysis hierarchy process, close values method and so on, which are used mainly to assess transformed environmental quality grade, but not quantitative calculate improved effect of atmospheric quality on the implementation before and after. This paper proposed the concept of the ideal target point, on this basis, proposed the concept of the atmospheric quality improved value and the atmospheric quality improved degree based on measure improved effect of atmospheric quality, and constructed the calculation method of both. The method is tested by the inspection data of atmospheric quality of a certain power plant desulphurization systems on the implementation before and after, and demonstrated the feasibility of the method.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: A kind of evaluation algorithm based on the comprehensive method for fatigue cracks fuzzy
publicationTitle: 2010 Second Pacific-Asia Conference on Circuits, Communications and System
abstract: This article has been retracted by the publisher.

articleTitle: Laterally driven tunable capacitors fabricated by a surface micromachining process for RF circuits
publicationTitle: 2010 Second Pacific-Asia Conference on Circuits, Communications and System
abstract: A laterally driven micro machined tunable capacitor is proposed. As an alternative to the traditional designs using two electrodes, three electrodes are used so that the series resistance could be reduced. This design also offers opportunities in the circuit design, since the DC-bias voltage is not applied on the two ports. To achieve the capacitance on the order of 0.4 pF, the electrodes are periodically arranged to form three groups of arrays. Thermal actuator arrays are employed to drive the movable electrodes. In order to simplify the design and fabrication, a structure using two layers to build the electrodes is provided, where the capacitance varies from 0.05 pF to 0.13 pF. This two-layer capacitor has been fabricated using a polysilicon surface micro machining process potentially compatible with CMOS process.

articleTitle: An Extenics-based color knowledge representation method for industrial design
publicationTitle: 2010 Second Pacific-Asia Conference on Circuits, Communications and System
abstract: Discusses the research contents and features of Industrial Design and Extenics at first. Based on the extensional theories of matter element, the color imformaton of product design has been defined, and the color molecule model has been built. By describing the color design knowledge and its attribute with the form of extensional matter element, the color knowledge representation model for industrial design based on the extensional methods has been structured, so as to put forward a method to solve the emotional design problems.

articleTitle: Studying of fuzzy logic control semi-active suspension based on improved genetic algorithm
publicationTitle: 2010 Second Pacific-Asia Conference on Circuits, Communications and System
abstract: Establishing a 2-DOFs of 1/4 semi-active suspension system model, Using genetic algorithm approach, fuzzy logic controller of the semi-active suspension was designed, simulated in the environment of Matlab/Simulink. The results of compared with the passive suspension demonstrate that this developed fuzzy logic controller based on genetic algorithm enhances the performance of the full car suspension system significantly.

articleTitle: Calculation of Nb3Sn superconducting magnet's inductance and distribution of electromagnetic force
publicationTitle: 2010 Second Pacific-Asia Conference on Circuits, Communications and System
abstract: The electromagnetic force distribution of Nb<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sub>Sn superconducting magnet is analyzed and obtained when the magnet is in the maximum magnetic field, then the request of magnet's structural strength is offered. Next, three methods of calculating the coil inductance are presented which are flux method, energy method and classical formula method. Adopting the above three methods, we calculate the coil inductance separately, obtaining accurate and consistent results . This would provide useful parameter for the quench protection of magnet.

articleTitle: Video segmentation by audio hashing
publicationTitle: 2010 Second Pacific-Asia Conference on Circuits, Communications and System
abstract: In this paper, a novel approach based on acoustic cues for automatic segmenting television stream into individual programs is proposed. This presented method is composed of the following steps: Several sets of repetitions in the audio track is detected by using silence detection and robust audio hashing; The found repetitions are treated as advertisements if the range of their length is from 5 seconds to 120 seconds; Programs are segmented from the recorded TV streams using the detected advertisements. Experiments on real-world TV recordings show the effectiveness of the proposed approach.

articleTitle: A support vector machine blind equalization algorithm based on orthogonal wavelet transform
publicationTitle: 2010 Second Pacific-Asia Conference on Circuits, Communications and System
abstract: For greatly overcoming the disadvantages of low convergence rate and local minima of constant modulus algorithm(CMA), a support vector machine blind equalization algorithm based on orthogonal wavelet transformation(WT-SVM) was proposed. The proposed WT-SVM algorithm employs the support vector machine for overcoming the local minima in convergence process and uses orthogonal wavelet transform to reduce the autocorrelation of the equalizer input signals and its tracking capability is improved via selecting a suitable kernel function. Computer simulation with underwater acoustic channels indicates that the proposed algorithm has fast convergence rate and low mean square error and can greatly overcomes the shortcomings of the traditional CMA algorithm.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: Research on evaluation methods of projects
publicationTitle: 2010 Second Pacific-Asia Conference on Circuits, Communications and System
abstract: Retracted.

articleTitle: A multipath QoS routing algorithm based on entropy in ad hoc networks
publicationTitle: 2010 Second Pacific-Asia Conference on Circuits, Communications and System
abstract: As the Ad Hoc network topology constantly changing, it often leads to routing reconstruction. In order to reduce the route reconstruction, the paper presents a node-disjoint multi-path QoS routing algorithm based on entropy in ad hoc network. The algorithm adopts the entropy metric to measure the routing stability and satisfies the bandwidth constraint. Therefore, it can obtain the node-disjoint multipath QoS routing. Simulation results show that the algorithm can reduce average latency and improve the success rate of data transmission.

articleTitle: Coordinated scheduling and precoding in multicell MIMO system
publicationTitle: 2010 Second Pacific-Asia Conference on Circuits, Communications and System
abstract: In this paper, we propose a joint user scheduling and precoding scheme in multicell MIMO system. In the proposed scheme, each user feeds back its preferable precoding vector index as well as a scalar to a BS, then the coordinated BSs share all users' feedback and work as a virtual enhanced BS. BSs determine a first user with maximum expected channel gain, and then use its preferable precoding vector to generate a unitary matrix. The columns of the newly generated matrix are used as precoding vectors for the following selected users. Numerical results show the effectiveness of the proposed method.

articleTitle: Design and implementation of college cadre evaluation system
publicationTitle: 2010 Second Pacific-Asia Conference on Circuits, Communications and System
abstract: Working quality evaluation of college cadre is an important part of teaching quality assurance system in college. College cadre evaluation system (CCES) is a necessary method to realize modernization of college. Evaluation System designed in this paper is convenient, efficient and adaptive. This paper discusses the design principle, the overall structure and the function of the system, which is based on ASP.NET 2.0, ADO.NET and SQL Server 2005. It has flexible evaluation range management, evaluation criteria management and data processing function, and solves the drawbacks of traditional evaluation methods effectively. The test shows that this system has achieved good results, and it is helpful for improving the efficiency and fairness of working quality evaluation.

articleTitle: Study on evaluation for integrate maturity of enterprises' informatization and industrialiazation
publicationTitle: 2010 Second Pacific-Asia Conference on Circuits, Communications and System
abstract: In this paper, the integration evaluation index system of enterprises' informatization and industrialization is established, combining the characteristics of integration into maturity model, and presents effectively improved the DEA model that can effectively evaluate integrate maturity of information and industrialization. It plays a strong guide role for our country and enterprises to construct informatization and industrialization.

articleTitle: Research on the solution of product configuration based on constraint satisfaction problem
publicationTitle: 2010 Second Pacific-Asia Conference on Circuits, Communications and System
abstract: The mapping from product configuration problem to constraint satisfaction problem (CSP) is built so that we can use CSP to present the knowledge of product configuration problem. The common solving methods for CSP are given and their weakness is pointed out Binary decision diagram is combined with arc consistency to form a new method, which can solve the product configuration without backtracking.

articleTitle: On constructing infinite families of optimal double loop networks
publicationTitle: 2010 Second Pacific-Asia Conference on Circuits, Communications and System
abstract: Double-loop networks (DLN) have been widely studied as architecture for local area networks. A double-loop digraph G(N; 1, s) has the set of vertices V={0, 1,..., N-1} and the adjacencies are defined by v→v + 1(mod N) and v→v +s(mod N) for any v ∈ V. With the approach proposed by Li and Xu et al., we give some methods to find infinite families of optimal DLN from k-tight(k≥0) optimal DLN and prove that it is possible to find infinite families of optimal DLN from any optimal DLN for 4≤N<;2176. Also we give some optimal DLN, from which we can not construct any infinite family of optimal DLN yet. With these results, some errata in the bibliography are corrected.

articleTitle: Design of power supply system for TMS320DM644x SoC
publicationTitle: 2010 Second Pacific-Asia Conference on Circuits, Communications and System
abstract: The power-supply sequence timing requirements of TMS320DM644x SoC and the main features of the buck DC-DC converter TPS54310 are presented. There is the circuit design, simulation and verification of the power supply based on TPS54310 for TMS320DM644x SoC through the theoretical analysis. The results show that the power supply has the advantages of high conversion efficiency, low power consumption, the stable and accurate output voltage, low ripple, etc. The TPS54310 output voltages are monitored in real time by the supervisory chip TPS3808GOl, which ensures the proper power-on sequence and reset, and makes the system operate stably and reliably. It can provide the beneficial reference for other SoC power supply systems.

articleTitle: QAM: QoS-assured management for interoperability and manageability for SOA
publicationTitle: 2010 Second Pacific-Asia Conference on Circuits, Communications and System
abstract: This paper presents the quality factors of web services with definition, classification, and sub-factors for interoperability and manageability. In SOA systems, service consumers and service providers are usually placed in different ownership domains. They are also developed independently on various platforms and loosely-coupled by network. Services are consumed generally without direct management by service consumers. As a result, interoperability and manageability for SOA systems are core issues for enabling SOA services. This paper addresses the new concept of sub-quality factors for interoperability and manageability in the view point of management. This is a result of SOA project designed for implementing and evaluating Korea e-government system.

articleTitle: Research on the PWM rectifier's voltage loop after the fuzzy algorithm is adopted
publicationTitle: 2010 Second Pacific-Asia Conference on Circuits, Communications and System
abstract: This paper expounds the double closed-loop control configuration which is composed by the outer voltage control loop and the inner current loop of the PWM rectifier, and the function of the outer voltage control loop is pointed out. To improve the control performance, a voltage controller whose voltage loop is designed by the fuzzy algorithm is used. The voltage error fuzzy variable e's membership functions is researched, and also the Rate of change of the voltage error fuzzy variable ce and the fuzzy variable ?u which is exported by fuzzy controller. Their influences to the control performance are considered. After the simulation experiments, it shows that the voltage outer loop fuzzy control is feasible and effective. The performance of the outer voltage control loop can be improved.

articleTitle: Maximum efficiency point tracking algorithm for photovoltaic power generating system
publicationTitle: 2010 Second Pacific-Asia Conference on Circuits, Communications and System
abstract: It proposes a new control algorithm to increase efficiency of a grid-connected photovoltaic power generating system. It finds a maximum efficiency point by considering the quantity of power generated from PV arrays, the number of inverters, and an efficiency of the inverter. And then it assigns the optimized power, which is in a high efficiency condition, on the PV inverter. Operational principle of the proposed maximum efficiency point tracking algorithm is given in detail. To verify the validity of the proposed method, computer-aided simulation is carried out.

articleTitle: Wireless campus network security situation and solutions
publicationTitle: 2010 Second Pacific-Asia Conference on Circuits, Communications and System
abstract: With the rapid development of wireless technology, WLAN technology is gradually integrate and replace the LAN technology, which has played an important role in promoting the development of campus information technology, will be an important component in campus network. Build a stable, safe, efficient, convenient wireless campus network has become the inevitable trend of development and construction of campus network. This paper describes the main advantages of WLAN, analyses the current major problems, studies the existing security measures, proposed a viewpoint from access control, authority distribution, content filtering, data encryption, user management, log auditing and several other Security aspects ,expected to provide some help with the construction of Digital Campus Network.

articleTitle: Multiuser detection based on Aitken-EM accelerated algorithm
publicationTitle: 2010 Second Pacific-Asia Conference on Circuits, Communications and System
abstract: The EM iterative algorithm is commonly used in recent years for missing data, which has the character of easy and popular applicability. But the EM algorithm has a fatal weakness that is slow convergence speed; base on that EM acceleration algorithm is proposed in order to solve the problem. In non-Gaussian noise simulation numerical is carried out, the results show that the proposed algorithm has a good performance, and compare with EM algorithm, the convergence speed is better than standard EM algorithm.

articleTitle: Research on multi-Agent cooperation mechanism based on game theory
publicationTitle: 2010 Second Pacific-Asia Conference on Circuits, Communications and System
abstract: Aiming at the cooperation of Agent in multi-Agent system, the game theory was introduced to the cooperation of Agent, and the multi-Agent cooperation mechanism based on game theory was established. The common multi-Agent cooperation model was analyzed, and an improved benevolent function was given, as well as the specific process of cooperation strategies and cooperation algorithms. At last, the cooperation mechanism of multi-Agent system was tested through the pursuit-evasion problem. The results of simulated experiments indicated that the multi-Agent cooperation mechanism based on game theory can be effectively used to cooperation of multi-Agent.

articleTitle: A improved dynamic background updating algorithm based on traffic video
publicationTitle: 2010 Second Pacific-Asia Conference on Circuits, Communications and System
abstract: Produced are varieties of information, such as tracking, speed, and recognition of cars as well as traffic density from trafiic video, while there are many tasks to be solved. In view of the faults of traditional method, a new dynamic background updating algorithm for traffic video is proposed. Based on researches of existing methods, the reason of weakness and shortage is analyzed, and improved the traditional method. Experiments show that it is practical method that is robust under lighting variations, fast in speed, satisfactory in vehicles detection.

articleTitle: A new labeling scheme using vectors based on polar coordinate system for dynamic XML data
publicationTitle: 2010 Second Pacific-Asia Conference on Circuits, Communications and System
abstract: The labeling problem of dynamic XML documents has been a hot search topic. In this paper, we propose a new labeling scheme LSVP. Each node is assigned a unique vector label which supports the representation of the ancestor-descendant relationships and sibling relationships between nodes. One floating-point corresponds to a vector based on Polar coordinate system (while two in Cartesian coordinates). Meanwhile, the problem of floating-point is resolved in our scheme. Hence, LSVP can completely avoid re-labeling and its memory cost is low.

articleTitle: A novel multiuser detector based on immune clone selection algorithm
publicationTitle: 2010 Second Pacific-Asia Conference on Circuits, Communications and System
abstract: Immune clone selection algorithm (ICSA) and the multi-user detection based on ICSA are studied. Similar to evolutionary algorithms, ICSA is an efficient tool in searching for the global optimum based on the representation of solutions as binary code. It shows better potential capability to solve the optimization problem than evolution algorithm. Two novel multi-user detectors are presented which are basic ICSA multi-user detector and hybrid ICSA multi-user detector with multi-stage detector (ICSA-MSD-MUD). For ICSA-MSD-MUD, the MSD is considered as an operator inside the ICSA algorithm. The hybrid detector can reach excellent performance by utilizing ICSA to implement global search and by utilizing MSD to implement local search. The results of simulation show the feasibility and validity of the presented multi-user detectors.

articleTitle: Design and implementation of network-based virtual keyboard for the remote alarm supervisory system
publicationTitle: 2010 Second Pacific-Asia Conference on Circuits, Communications and System
abstract: In this paper, a high-performance and low-price security alarm supervisory system with virtual keyboards and PC supervisory software is designed. The implementation of both hardware and software of the virtual keyboards are presented. Experiments and tests have shown that the network-based alarm supervisory system is stable and efficiency. The maintenance costs drop drastically.

articleTitle: Study on communication model of semi-autonomous Agent
publicationTitle: 2010 Second Pacific-Asia Conference on Circuits, Communications and System
abstract: This paper gives the concept of semi-autonomous Agent firstly and points out the important significance of semi-autonomous Agent communication model. Then study on three parts, semi-autonomous Agent communication mechanism and structure of multi-agents system communication and language of semi-autonomous Agent communication, After that, the paper educes conclusion of semi-autonomous Agent communication model and gives the interior disposal mechanism of semi-autonomous Agent communication and content of extend KQML communication language.

articleTitle: An operation mode of manufacturing system for Traditional Chinese Medicine based on equipment integration
publicationTitle: 2010 Second Pacific-Asia Conference on Circuits, Communications and System
abstract: Traditional Chinese Medicine is one of China's gems. While throughout a long period in history, such problems as extensive management, backwardness of equipment and traditional manufacturing mode mostly employed in the process of production were important factors that blocked the development of Chinese pharmaceutical enterprises. Considering the particular features of the production of traditional Chinese medicine and its present situation, this paper proposes a production operating mode of equipment integration and introduces the mode in detail based on an analysis of the correlation of equipment and every links in the whole process of production. The application of this manufacturing mode was tested in a pharmaceutical enterprise in Guizhou Province.

articleTitle: Design and realization of real-time data management system in customs surveillance zone
publicationTitle: 2010 Second Pacific-Asia Conference on Circuits, Communications and System
abstract: It is necessary to realize real-time data management system in customs surveillance zone (RDMCS) for the customs' modernization. According to the feature of the enterprise data in Zhenjiang customs surveillance zone, the paper analyzes the current regulatory model, the kind of the enterprise real-time data and the platform for interaction with the current systems, designs the real-time data management system in customs surveillance zone based on the .NET technology, solves the malpractice of traditional regulatory approach effectively, and achieves the real-time regulation of enterprise data. In the respect of the security technology, this system utilizes the technology of stratified design, database, framework architecture and so on, effectively solves the problems of safety, efficiency and real-time in data transmission. This system has been operated in sixteen enterprises and obtains the good effects, which indicates that the system not only improves the efficiency of customs surveillance, but also achieves the real-time automation of data management, so it is very suitable for the application of data management in customs surveillance.

articleTitle: The application of on-line operating system for preventing from operation mistakes based on ZigBee technology
publicationTitle: 2010 Second Pacific-Asia Conference on Circuits, Communications and System
abstract: Currently, off-line defense against the current operating system can not accurately detect the device error status, can not really prevent “walking space” and the construction of complex line against wrong operating system, electromagnetic interference and other drawbacks, the paper offers wireless communication line based on the operating system of error prevention. The system can accurately detect real-time device status, complete “defense away empty”, the construction is simple, no interference. The error system of defense for enhancing the safe operation of substations, reducing the complexity of construction of great significance.

articleTitle: Notice of Violation of IEEE Publication Principles: An efficient Adaptive multi-hop routing protocol to avoid congestion for Wireless Sensor Networks
publicationTitle: 2010 Second Pacific-Asia Conference on Circuits, Communications and System
abstract:

by K. Saleem, N.Fisal, S. Hafizah, S. Kamilah, R.A. Rashid
in the International Journal of Recent Trends in Engineering, Vol 2, No 1, November 2009, pp. 93-97


This paper deals with the model of Adaptive multi-hop routing algorithm for Wireless Sensor Network (WSN) and its results are presented. Certain parameters like energy level, delay and velocity are considered. These decisions will come up with the optimal and organized route for WSN. In addition, the stated algorithm is enhanced with the multipath capability to avoid congestion state in WSN. Eventually, the enhanced feature helps WSN in maximizing the data throughput rate and minimizing the data loss. Moreover, multi-hop routing in WSN is affected by new nodes constantly entering or leaving the network. Therefore, the self-optimized and self-aware mechanism is required to handle the problems arise very frequently in WSNs. The ant colony optimization has shown excellent results in discovering routes for WSN.

articleTitle: Study and application of path ambiguity based on SVM and license plate recognition
publicationTitle: 2010 Second Pacific-Asia Conference on Circuits, Communications and System
abstract: This paper studied on the ambiguous path identification system based on license plate recognition technology, studied on the basic principle and application of the state discrimination of license plate matching vectors based on support vector machine (SVM), and proved that the discriminant effect of SVM is better than discriminant analysis and K-nearest neighbor (KNN) method by experiments. Finally this paper provided the distribution algorithm for the toll of ambiguous paths based on SVM.

articleTitle: Design and implementation of wireless sensor network monitoring system
publicationTitle: 2010 Second Pacific-Asia Conference on Circuits, Communications and System
abstract: To promote the information technology development of the enterprise, by means of wireless sensor network, the industrial monitoring system is designed and is suitable for industrial automation and process Automation network. The hardware and the software of the system are mainly introduced, and the test results are given Industrial wireless sensor network technology is a new communication technology for information exchange between devices, and it will play an important role for improving product quality, reducing production costs and it is very suitable for used in harsh environments of industrial fields with anti-interference ability, low energy consumption, real-time characteristics.

articleTitle: Modeling and analysis of active sensor networks based on multi-robots
publicationTitle: 2010 Second Pacific-Asia Conference on Circuits, Communications and System
abstract: The great environment coverage capability and the faster response to dynamic changes are of advantage to the future application of military affairs and environment monitoring. Network Modeling plays a crucial role in improving the efficiency of self-organization, motion planning and controlling. Proceeding with initial node deployment, environment, node and network modeling, the objective is to build the model including the robot dynamics, communication restriction and the dynamic interaction among robots simultaneously.

articleTitle: Research on patent information retrieval based on ontology and its application
publicationTitle: 2010 Second Pacific-Asia Conference on Circuits, Communications and System
abstract: In the economic environment of the world at present, the competition among the enterprises is the competition of the knowledge right. Because the patent is the most concentrated carrier of the knowledge, the efficiency of patent retrieval and utilization is an important way of the enterprises to understand their competitors, track the developed trend of the industrial technique and improve the independent innovation capability and core competitiveness of their own. But at present patent information retrieval systems based on the keyword match can't satisfy the users' demands on accuracy and completeness. So, this paper proposes to establish patent domain ontology, and expand the query based on it to realize semantic retrieval and improve the comprehensiveness and accuracy of the patent information retrieval.

articleTitle: Near-threshold adiabatic flip-flops based on PAL-2N circuits in nanometer CMOS processes
publicationTitle: 2010 Second Pacific-Asia Conference on Circuits, Communications and System
abstract: This paper presents ultra low-power adiabatic flip-flops that operate on near-threshold region. The near-threshold flip-flops are realized by PAL-2N (pass-transistor adiabatic logic with NMOS pull-down configuration) circuits. A near-threshold mode-10 counter is verified. All circuits are simulated using NCSU PDK 45nm technology by varying supply voltage from O.2V to O.9V with O.1V steps. Based on the simulation results, the adiabatic flip-flops that operate on medium-voltage region can not only keep reasonable speed but also reduce greatly energy consumptions.

articleTitle: A research of the remote enterprise management system
publicationTitle: 2010 Second Pacific-Asia Conference on Circuits, Communications and System
abstract: In order to achieve the wireless management on production-related data, a design method of enterprise remote management system based on RFID (Radio Frequency Identification) technology is proposed in this paper. A new chip nRF24LEl for the wireless microwave system as a core component is used to build active RFID hardware circuit. The tag and reader have simple configuration, stable performance, anti-interference ability, a wide range for read and write and easy expansion of system functions. In the production and warehousing management of the products and raw materials, the remote automatic monitoring information can be achieved.

articleTitle: A kind of dynamic encryption algorithm and its application
publicationTitle: 2010 Second Pacific-Asia Conference on Circuits, Communications and System
abstract: The problems of conventional encryption algorithm were briefed, a kind of dynamic encryption algorithm was brought forward, and its application in network communication was given. An interface for most of the encryption algorithm was defined, which the encryption algorithm consistent with that can be added to the algorithm; the basic principle of the transparent transmission in NAT server was analyzed, which is used to automatically record the end to end information of data communication that provide thread-safe synchronous communication; three-way handshake protocol was used to ensure the strict consensus when changing encrypt information, which avoid the client and server-side encryption of information inconsistencies at any time when information changes. Finally, a kind of no upper intervention thread-safe dynamic encryption algorithm was achieved.
